checks.scope: v8 plus final visible_flag_guard; no broad strategy replacement
checks.production_and_shared_budget: a_clean resolves affordability and legal owned spawn sites before support ledger
checks.warrior_support: starts with current W, adds accepted W production, subtracts every W departure and adds every W arrival including TELE
checks.simultaneous_order: post-move cell W totals include all sources without incorrectly allowing moved-in units to move twice; a_clean uses original-plus-produced departure inventory
checks.F_count_and_commands: rewrites destination only or removes an F movement; no increased count or command count
checks.TELE: replacement becomes one adjacent normal move; a canceled TELE is not reassigned, so no new capacity use
checks.combat_equality: enemy W > support triggers; equality preserves original move as W ties eliminate enemy W before F elimination

limits: Only current visible enemy W triggers; future enemy moves/spawn and TELE are not guaranteed safe.
Threat estimate from neighboring enemy W ranks safe fallback cells but is not a multi-cell shared-budget adversary model.
If no stationary-safe adjacent/stay cell exists, dropping the move may still lose the F; this is not an all-situations safety guarantee.
Already stationary F without a move is outside this guard.
A canceled F TELE can leave capacity unused; it does not create an extra TELE.
No claim of improved whole-game strength before fresh quota selection/confirmation.
tests: Independent SDK and official one-turn cases owned by prior agent; this report is code inspection only.
